candidates.name: loro
candidates.rationale: ADR-001 final decision. frf-crdt already uses loro 1.13.x. storage-provider crate must drop automerge 0.5 and adopt loro.

candidates.name: iroh
candidates.rationale: Stable QUIC P2P release June 15 2026. IrohDocsAdapter stub exists in substrate/storage-provider. API renames: iroh-net merged, NodeAddr→EndpointAddr, NodeId→EndpointId, discovery→address_lookup.

candidates.name: iroh-gossip
candidates.rationale: Epidemic peer discovery via BLAKE3(operator_pubkey || 'sovereign-sync-v1') TopicId. Three-layer discovery: pkarr bootstrap → iroh-gossip → mDNS LAN shortcut.

candidates.name: rmcp
candidates.rationale: Official Rust MCP SDK (modelcontextprotocol/rust-sdk), released 2026-06-23. Both MCP server and client. stdio + streamable HTTP. tools/resources/prompts. OAuth 2.0. elicitation. proc-macros.

candidates.name: redb
candidates.rationale: Embedded crash-safe persistence. Used in place of Temporal.io for sync-service durable state. Simpler than SQLite for binary KV storage (CRDT metadata, peer table, session state).

candidates.name: statig
candidates.rationale: Hierarchical state machine for subsystem lifecycle FSMs (connecting, syncing, idle, error). Alternatives: plain enums (simpler but no hierarchy), s-machine (unmaintained).

candidates.name: burn
candidates.rationale: On-device embedding inference without ONNX runtime. NDArray backend. UAR uses this for VectorMatcher (skill embedding). MiniLM-L6-v2 model. 22M params, 80ms on M1.

candidates.name: usearch
candidates.rationale: ANNS vector index, in-process, ARM64-native. UAR uses this for VectorMatcher. Fast approximate nearest neighbor search for skill embedding similarity.

candidates.name: axum
candidates.rationale: Already used in flint-gate. SSE support via axum::response::Sse. AG-UI and A2UI endpoints port directly from flint-gate patterns.

candidates.name: @number0/iroh
candidates.rationale: Correct NAPI npm package for iroh (Node.js only). NOT iroh-js (that is RPC client for iroh.network cloud). Released post-June 15 2026 alongside iroh 1.0.0 stable.

candidates.name: loro-crdt
candidates.rationale: Correct npm WASM package for Loro (ships 4 targets: bundler, nodejs, web, base64). NOT loro-wasm (old unmaintained). Current version 1.13.6.

candidates.name: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk
candidates.rationale: Official TypeScript MCP SDK. Stable (v2 alpha deferred Q3 2026). Used in cherry-studio MCP server factory pattern.

candidates.name: liter-llm (TypeScript NAPI)
candidates.rationale: NAPI-RS Node.js bindings for 140+ provider LLM access. Provider auto-detected from model name prefix. Already in vendor/universal-agent-runtime. For TypeScript SDK only — Rust binary uses direct API clients in Phase A.

candidates.name: AG-UI types (port from flint-gate)
candidates.rationale: flint-gate/src/stream/ag_ui.rs contains production-ready AG-UI event types (15 event types, parse + serialize + inject_metadata). Port directly into sovereign-orchestrator. No upstream Rust AG-UI SDK exists.

candidates.name: A2UI types (port from flint-gate)
candidates.rationale: flint-gate/src/stream/a2ui.rs contains production-ready A2UI intent types (7 intents, scope mapping, A2UiProcessor). Port directly. Required scopes: a2ui:render, a2ui:state, a2ui:navigate, a2ui:modal, a2ui:toast, a2ui:input, a2ui:stream.

build_required.description: Implement the currently-stubbed IrohDocsAdapter in substrate/storage-provider/src/iroh_docs.rs using iroh 1.0.0 stable API. Key API renames must be applied.
Delete AutomergeEngine. Implement LoroAdapter using loro 1.13.x. Patterns from frf-crdt (LoroDeltaApplier, apply_delta, InMemoryCrdtStore) are the reference.
New Axum binary crate aggregating: iroh P2P, iroh-gossip discovery, Loro CRDT, redb persistence, rmcp client pool, skill matching engine (Burn+USearch), AG-UI + A2UI endpoints.
Pool of rmcp 1.8.0 clients loaded from mcp-servers.json config. Unified tool registry. Tool aggregation → LLM context. Skill invocation via MCP tool call.
Implement UAR stub: prompt LLM with skill catalog + user query → JSON match list. Use liter-llm HTTP proxy (TypeScript) or direct Anthropic/OpenAI client (Rust).
Port UAR SkillMatchingAlgorithm (5 variants) + SkillService.match_skills logic. Add SkillActivationResult with activation_method, similarity_score, trigger_tokens, matched_keywords for SSE payload.

build_required.capability: AG-UI endpoint + task schema + A2UI streaming + inter-node proxy
build_required.description: GET /sovereign/tasks/schema, POST /sovereign/tasks/{id}/run (AG-UI SSE), GET /sovereign/tasks/{id}/status. Task schema JSON for Tauri UI binding. Inter-node proxy via iroh QUIC.
Thin reqwest-based SDK: SovereignClient struct, connect(), invoke_task(), stream_task() (SSE consumer). Used for server-to-server calls.

rejected.name: Signal Protocol / libsignal
rejected.reason: REJECTED (assessment ADR-002): iroh QUIC TLS 1.3 + Ed25519 node keys are sufficient. Double Ratchet + X3DH adds 50k lines of complexity with no threat model justification.

rejected.name: Temporal.io (Rust SDK)
rejected.reason: REJECTED (assessment ADR-03): Rust SDK is Public Preview (prerelease). Requires server cluster. redb 4.1.0 handles durable state for P2P node. Temporal deferred to cloud substrate if ever needed.

rejected.name: loro-go / iroh Go FFI
rejected.reason: REJECTED (assessment ADR-05): loro-go referenced in README but no public repo exists. iroh has no Go bindings. Go SDK uses HTTP REST over Axum — no FFI required.

rejected.name: AutomergeEngine
rejected.reason: DELETE: YAGNI. Never shipped to production. Replaced by LoroAdapter.

rejected.name: iroh-js (npm)
rejected.reason: REJECTED: RPC client for iroh.network cloud only. Use @number0/iroh (NAPI) instead.
